title: Relic reported missing at Hazratbal
detail: A relic believed by devotees to be a hair of the Prophet Muhammad was reported missing from the Hazratbal shrine in Srinagar, prompting protests.

title: Communal violence reported in Khulna
detail: Contemporary United Nations reporting recorded violent disturbances in Khulna and surrounding areas of East Pakistan, including killings, arson, looting and damage to property.
